name: Microgrid storage emergency-stop status input
summary: Receives the storage installation's declared emergency-stop state for coordination.
description: Receives the storage installation's declared emergency-stop state for coordination. Storage coordination combines the battery's energy limits with the converter's electrical capability and the microgrid's operating demand. State of charge, allowable power and connection status describe different aspects of availability.

In a microgrid with a battery energy storage system, the controller can request discharge to support a power deficit while the battery management and conversion systems enforce their own operating limits. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Storage emergency-system status” at the input and “Storage unavailable or restrained state” at the output. The storage cause-and-effect design governs the response.
